items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 52:1
items.html: The holy names are explanations of how the lights alluded to in them come into attainment, in such a way that the name of a degree explains the ways of attainment in that degree. (Part 1, Inner Observation, Item 5)
